about:
Energy Technologies, Inc. (ETI) operates from Mansfield, Ohio, where it designs and builds rugged power electronics for demanding environments. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

ETI manufactures a broad range of high-reliability power equipment including uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), DC/AC inverters, frequency converters, power conditioners, power distribution units (PDUs), solar power systems, battery backup modules, engine generators, and rugged computers. Products are offered in rackmount, NEMA-rated, portable, and custom configurations. The company emphasizes that its designs originate as rugged rather than being adapted from commercial off-the-shelf units, and it validates hardware against military standards such as MIL-STD-167-1 and MIL-STD-810.

The company serves defense, industrial, telecommunications, and medical sectors. Its product families — Rugged Power™, Military Power®, Tactical Power®, Airborne Power®, Industrial Power Source®, and Extreme Power Source™ — address applications from fixed-site data centers to mobile tactical shelters, microgrids, and airborne platforms. Customers include military programs, telecom infrastructure operators, and industrial facilities requiring hardened power conditioning.

ETI states its differentiation lies in ground-up rugged design, full Mil-Spec compliance across product lines, and integrated solutions such as combined UPS/PDU chassis that reduce rack space and cabling. The firm also develops deployable tactical power plants, solar and wind generation kits, and environmental control units for field use.
